blocks.text: VSEPR model molecules ki shape ka andaza aur explanation (wazahat) to deta hai, lekin yeh nahi batata ke bond banta kyun hai. VBT (valence bond theory) bond banne aur molecule ki shape, dono ko samjhati hai. Covalent bond ko samjhane ka yeh tareeqa molecule ko atoms ka combination (majmooa) maanta hai. VBT ke postulates (buniyadi baatein) yeh hain:

items: Covalent bond tab banta hai jab do atoms ke valence shells ke half-filled (aadhe bhare) orbitals, jin ki energy milti julti ho, aapas mein overlap karte hain (ek doosre par charh jate hain).
Orbitals ka overlap jitna zyada, bond utna mazboot.
Covalent bonds ki ek khas direction hoti hai (directional). Bond ki direction overlap karne wale orbitals ki shape aur overlap ke tareeqe se decide hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: VBT VSEPR mein kya addition (izafa) karti hai, aur do orbitals ke bond banane ke liye kya condition (shart) hai?
blocks.explanation: VSEPR sirf shape batata hai; VBT yeh bhi batati hai ke bond kyun banta hai. Bond ke liye har atom ek half-filled valence orbital laye, dono ki energy milti julti ho, aur woh overlap karein; zyada overlap yani mazboot bond, aur overlap ki direction bond ki direction hai.

items: VBT bond banne aur shape dono samjhati hai: covalent bond milti julti energy ke half-filled valence orbitals ka overlap hai; zyada overlap, mazboot bond; bonds directional hain.
